description: This file contains the definition of the EAPMController class, responsible for managing external account/protocol integrations within the SuiteCRM application. It handles actions such as OAuth authentication, saving external account details, and access control.

classes.name: EAPMController
classes.description: Controller class managing external account integrations within the SuiteCRM platform, including OAuth workflows, saving, and access management.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the incoming request, checks user permissions if action is an admin action, then calls parent process method.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Handles failed authentication or processing attempts, logs error, and redirects to an appropriate URL.

methods.name: pre_save
methods.description: Performs pre-save operations, including password handling, API loading, and setting validation status.

methods.name: post_save
methods.description: Handles post-save actions, including OAuth handling and redirects based on context.

methods.name: action_oauth
methods.description: Executes OAuth authentication flow and handles window closing or redirection after OAuth process.

methods.name: pre_QuickSave
methods.description: Prepares the bean for quick save operations by retrieving or setting EAPM login info.

methods.name: action_QuickSave
methods.description: Executes quick save and possibly OAuth action depending on API.

methods.name: post_QuickSave
methods.description: Handles post-quick save procedures, including calling post_save.

methods.name: pre_Reauthenticate
methods.description: Prepares reauthentication process by calling pre_save.

methods.name: action_Reauthenticate
methods.description: Performs reauthentication, including OAuth login checks if applicable.

methods.name: action_FlushFileCache
methods.description: Flushes document cache of the external API if supported.
